adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, the embed_controller.rb shows that when no topic_id is found, it calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` (line 14-15). However, the test in spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb at lines 41-47 expects `TopicRetriever.new` to be called directly and `retriever.retrieve` to be invoked synchronously. Since the controller actually enqueues a job rather than calling TopicRetriever directly, this test expectation is incorrect and the test would fail. The test mocks TopicRetriever but the controller never instantiates TopicRetriever directly - it enqueues Jobs::RetrieveTopic which internally uses TopicRetriever.
